name: NUBWO N7 Wired Gaming Headset
description:
Bring game audio and voice input together with the NUBWO N7 wired headset. The supplier lists 50 mm drivers, a microphone and a 3.5 mm connector, giving you one headset for listening and supported voice use. Its 1.6-metre cable provides a wired connection without Bluetooth pairing or a headset battery to recharge.

The over-head design has cushions described as imitation protein leather. Black and black/red options are offered, with an additional black unidirectional-microphone version in the selector. This gives you choices of appearance and microphone configuration, but the differences should be confirmed before buying. The listed package includes the headset, colour box and instructions.

Check your device's audio socket to see whether an adapter is needed for both sound and microphone use. A 3.5 mm plug does not establish universal compatibility. The stated weight is 470 g, so consider weight and fit for your own comfort. Sound, microphone performance and brand authenticity have not been independently verified. Ask about the actual warranty terms rather than assuming unconditional replacement for every type of damage.

name: Kuabe Metal In-Ear Wired Earphones
description:

The wired format avoids Bluetooth pairing and an earphone battery to manage, provided you choose a plug that matches your device.

Select a 3.5 mm or digital Type-C connector in white, pink, black or moonlight blue. That choice lets you match both your device connection and preferred appearance. The boxed bundle includes a storage pouch and spare ear tips, giving you extras for keeping the set together and trying the supplied tip options. A bagged version is also offered and should not be assumed to include those extras.

Confirm microphone and inline-control support for your phone before buying. The title promotes a metal-style design and bass-focused sound, but the readable details do not establish a particular sound-quality level or complete housing construction. Check the exact connector, package contents and fit rather than choosing from colour alone. Audio performance is not independently tested.

name: Replacement Microphone for HyperX Cloud II Wireless
description:
Replace a compatible headset's microphone without buying a complete new headset with this aftermarket boom-microphone accessory. The supplier markets it for HyperX Cloud II Wireless and related Hurricane versions. A black flexible design, about 16 cm long, gives you a replacement part to consider when the rest of your headset is still usable. Compatibility must be confirmed first.

The listing contains M1, M2 and M28 selections, which should not be treated as interchangeable. Match the option to your exact headset model and socket. A 3.5 mm plug is described, but plug size alone does not prove the shape, wiring or clearance will fit your headset. Individual resealable-bag packaging is listed.

One section describes a straight plug and another an angled plug, so request confirmation of the actual part before buying. This is not a complete headset or a verified genuine HyperX accessory. Microphone sound and fit have not been independently tested. Check the chosen version and electrical compatibility rather than relying only on a similar product name or appearance.
